name: text-to-3d-codex
description: Text to a static, textured GLB for Codex agents: one-command local startup, FLUX.2 klein, a Vulkan-only TRELLIS.2 engine, triangle budgets, and a turntable viewer.

interface.shortDescription: Generate local, game-ready GLB assets from one description
interface.longDescription: Start the local harness, render one reference image with FLUX.2 klein, reconstruct it into a textured GLB on a Vulkan-only TRELLIS.2 engine, and open it in the bundled turntable viewer.
defaultPrompt: Use /text-to-3d <subject> to generate a textured GLB locally.
